fields.label: Business Name
fields.description: StartupOS instance name; the engine sanitizes it and rejects unsafe names

fields.label: Document Scope
fields.options:
Full Suite
Plan Chapters
Pitch Deck
Financial Model
Briefs
fields.description: Which deliverables this request records; the compiler always regenerates the whole suite (its output pruning depends on that)

fields.label: Questions File
fields.description: The executive's answered questions.md; copied to instances/business/<name>/questions.md at processing time. Leave empty when the workspace already holds the profile

fields.label: Workspace Root
fields.description: StartupOS workspace path on this bench; empty uses the engine's documented resolution order ($STARTUPOS_ROOT, .startupos.json, Frappe site path)

fields.label: Compliance Folder
fields.description: Optional path to the compliance evidence folder passed to the engine

fields.label: Render Binaries
fields.description: Also render the investor deck .pptx and financial model .xlsx; Pitch Deck / Financial Model scopes render regardless. With an artifact selection, only binaries whose source document was selected are rendered

fields.label: Artifacts
fields.description: Optional comma/newline-separated artifact stems (e.g. business_profile). Named: the engine compiles exactly these plus the compliance log and prunes nothing (document_scope must stay Full Suite). Empty: the full suite compiles and the scope picks the deliverables, unchanged

fields.label: Render A4 Profile
fields.description: Also render the branded A4 company profile (cover + content SVG pages, a4-poster preset) when this request delivers business_profile.md. Slots are filled only from real compiled answers

fields.label: Design System
fields.description: Palette for the A4 profile render; empty uses the engine's default system

fields.label: Profile Pack Folder
fields.description: Path to the company-profile template pack on this bench (examples/templates/company-profile/ from RokctAI/designer, which does not ship in the designer-compliance pip wheel); empty looks beside the installed designer package

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Queued
Processing
Ready
Delivered
Failed

fields.label: Error Message
fields.description: Set only when status is Failed

fields.label: Warnings
fields.description: The engine's honest warnings verbatim, plus every unanswered question by its human label

fields.label: Completeness
fields.description: Answered fraction of questions.md reported by the engine (0-100)
